title: VASP FeRh: ferromagnetic bands, spin-polarized and with spin-orbit
summary: B2 FeRh, ferromagnetic, from two VASP runs: collinear spin-polarized and with spin-orbit coupling. The PAO Hamiltonian (Fe 3D 4S 4P 4D 5S 5P, Rh 4D 4F 5S 5P 5D) and the band structure of each. Needs your own VASP runs and POTCAR.

steps.label: FeRh bands, collinear spin-polarized
steps.note: needs the VASP runs of nscf_nspin2/ (vasprun.xml, WAVECAR, POTCAR); writes output_nspin2/ and FeRh_nspin2_VASP.png

steps.label: FeRh bands with spin-orbit coupling
steps.note: needs the VASP runs of nscf_soc/ (vasprun.xml, WAVECAR, POTCAR); writes output_soc/ and FeRh_soc_VASP.png
